sources.content:
import math
import torch
from flash_attn import flash_attn_varlen_func


@torch.no_grad()
def run(q, k_cache, v_cache, qo_indptr, kv_indptr, kv_indices, sm_scale):
    total_q, num_qo_heads, head_dim = q.shape
    num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, _ = k_cache.shape

    # Gather KV from cache
    k_cache_flat = k_cache.squeeze(1)
    v_cache_flat = v_cache.squeeze(1)
    kv_indices_long = kv_indices.to(torch.long)
    k_gathered = k_cache_flat[kv_indices_long]
    v_gathered = v_cache_flat[kv_indices_long]

    qo_indptr_i32 = qo_indptr.to(torch.int32)
    kv_indptr_i32 = kv_indptr.to(torch.int32)

    q_lens = qo_indptr_i32[1:] - qo_indptr_i32[:-1]
    kv_lens = kv_indptr_i32[1:] - kv_indptr_i32[:-1]
    max_seqlen_q = int(q_lens.max().item()) if q_lens.numel() > 0 else 0
    max_seqlen_k = int(kv_lens.max().item()) if kv_lens.numel() > 0 else 0

    output = torch.zeros((total_q, num_qo_heads, head_dim), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=q.device)
    lse = torch.full((total_q, num_qo_heads), -float('inf'), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)

    if max_seqlen_q == 0 or max_seqlen_k == 0:
        return output, lse

    result = flash_attn_varlen_func(
        q, k_gathered, v_gathered,
        qo_indptr_i32, kv_indptr_i32,
        max_seqlen_q, max_seqlen_k,
        causal=True,
        softmax_scale=sm_scale,
        return_attn_probs=True,
    )
    out_full, lse_full, _ = result

    # Convert LSE: (num_heads, total) -> (total, num_heads), natural log -> log2
    lse_full = lse_full.transpose(0, 1).contiguous() / math.log(2.0)

    # Replace any +inf or NaN with -inf (these positions have no valid KV due to causal mask)
    lse_full = torch.where(
        torch.isnan(lse_full) | (lse_full > 0) & torch.isinf(lse_full),
        torch.full_like(lse_full, -float('inf')),
        lse_full,
    )

    # Replace any NaN/inf in output with zeros
    out_full = torch.where(
        torch.isnan(out_full) | torch.isinf(out_full),
        torch.zeros_like(out_full),
        out_full,
    )

    return out_full, lse_full
